dogecoin.text: @CryptoBully In the early days of Doge, the DB Devs assisted Dogecoin despite the innate competition. They deserve every success.

@Cointelegraph This is why the general public buys Dogecoin. “But get past complex financial transactions” either claim the complexity as a feature, or simplify the user experience.

Check your old Dogeparty addresses. It has arisen from the ashes. I had a nice lump of #Dogecoin in one of my  #dogeparty addresses. Like a gift of $doge and $xdp from 7 years ago. I thought I had swept them all years ago.

@markchadwickx @dogecoin has a token layer preceding $HBAR that is completely decentralized @DogepartyXDP. Both have time in the market with no entities responsible for dilution to pay themselves operating costs, which enhances public trust in #doge over #hbar

$doge will hit $1 before $HBAR this run. Why? Because of @hedera and the @HederaFndn wholehearted commitment to slow mediocrity and a strict adherence to historically unproductive efforts when KISS rarely fails.

@markchadwickx $doge has a leaderless defi layer of tokenization and an operational DEX. The  token distribution is organic, rules based, and transparent. $hbar pretends to do those things, changes rules on the fly, gate keeps, and is run by centralized policy makers lining their own pockets.
